The fix is complete and public tests pass.

The problem was that `self.edges` was a dictionary keyed by `(head, tail)`, so when the same head/tail pair had multiple relations, later declarations overwrote earlier ones. I changed it to store a list of distinct `(head, relation, tail)` triples, deduplicating exact duplicates via a `seen` set, and updated `get_neighbors` to iterate over that list and return each incident relationship once.
